I'm absolutely loving Nature's Basket! The staff are super helpful and knowledgeable, always ready to guide me through their amazing selection of gourmet goodies. Love the upscale vibe of the store, it's so refreshing to shop in a place that feels like a treat 😊.

featured_reviews.review_text: A good store with a variety of collections in exotic fruits, juices, bakery items, and cheese. It’s well maintained and offers good ambience to customers. though the prices are slightly on the expensive side, the store is a definite visit for those who would like to try fruits like cherries, raspberries, blueberries, rare plums, et cetera.

featured_reviews.name: sangeeta chaubal
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best known gourmet grocery store - Nature's Basket, has its branch located on Hill Road, Bandra. It is one of the best stores for gourmet grocery, fresh produces, bakery, meat and desserts.

They have large range of varieties when it comes to cheese and meat. Variety of fresh fish is also available.

Cold cuts of chicken, lamb, pork and turkey is also available. One should definitely check the dates though before buying.

The staff is polite and friendly. They also have vast range of beer and wine collection.

Now with Christmas round the corner, they have lot of Christmas varieties and delicacies. A beautiful  Christmas tree adds its charm to this beautiful store.

Tip: It is better to check the expiry dates for cold cuts and bakery products before buying. Sometimes the products are close to expiry.

Nature's Basket also started serving sushi.

featured_reviews.review_text: Always Happy and satisfied to visit this particular Nature basket for their products and service. Vegetables , fruits and milk products are fresh. The staff is warm and one particular mention Prerna (staff member) who is always available for facilitating great service , delivery and helping choose the best product.

featured_reviews.name: sanket bhole
featured_reviews.review_text: Nature’s Basket offers a great selection of premium and imported groceries, and the store is well-organized with helpful staff. I appreciate the quality and variety of products available. However, during my recent visit, I noticed some hygiene issues in certain areas that could be improved. Maintaining better cleanliness would really enhance the overall shopping experience. I hope the management looks into this, as it’s otherwise a very good store.

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: A good mix of imported and Indian products but what is the with the stench??!! The place stinks. The smell is unbearable. Its the smell of pigeons roosting so there must be a spot near their airconditioning units. Told them about it several times over the past year but the smell is getting worse. Cant stand in the store to buy even a single product and wait to pay for it, this is a real health hazard to customers and staff. Please get this fixed. I will change my review once done. Thanks

featured_reviews.name: devang parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nature Basket the food store is an absolute gem! The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a clean, well-organized space and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The quality of the products is outstanding — fresh produce, neatly arranged shelves, and a wide variety of items to choose from. Whether you’re shopping for everyday essentials or something special, this store has it all.

The staff is friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile. The overall shopping experience is smooth and enjoyable. It’s clear that the store takes pride in offering excellent service and high-quality products.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, pleasant place to shop for food!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text: December 2025: In store experience I had was me noticing that most of the products were having worn out packaging though the expiry dates were within valid time. After bringing a ladder with the help of the staff together we hunted for items that were actually fresh within the store. After careful selection I was yet a victim of purchasing items that were bad in quality. The chocolates section was having old wornout packaging and the inside product was exposed, though expiry dates were valid. Counter had maybe a few good fresh chocolates. The meat section purchase I made was to be good for 5 days as informed but after cooking the chicken the next day the stench of bad meat was noticed by my family. Though brands like conscious food is available here after taking the packet in the car I noticed that it was filled with ants as the package was exposed enough for them to enter within the store shelf. Products unorganised and dust gathering on them in the mid sections. The product from fridge section I got being dosa batter, had bad smell and taste though the expiry dates were valid, post cooking experience. Upon pointing out to staff a few products were bad I had later come to the understanding that most of the items were bad in store. Even after carefully hunting for items I failed to get good quality products on my spending. This was once my favourite store for a long time. Would not recommend to anyone today unfortunately.

featured_reviews.review_text: Great store with a wide variety of quality products. Clean, well-organized, and the staff is helpful—shopping here is always a pleasant experience! 😊

featured_reviews.review_text: The staff here at Nature's Basket Mahalaxmi Store is friendly and helpful, making it easy to choose the perfect gift. Highly recommended for quality and service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Byculla Fruit Market, situated in the Sant Gadge Maharaj Mandai, is one of Mumbai's oldest and most vibrant wholesale markets, renowned for its extensive selection of fresh fruits and vegetables.  Operating from early morning hours, the market becomes a bustling hub where traders and customers engage in lively negotiations, reflecting the energetic atmosphere of Mumbai's traditional marketplaces.

Highlights

Diverse Produce: The market offers a wide variety of fruits and vegetables, catering to both individual shoppers and bulk buyers.

Historical Significance: Established in 1939 and expanded in 1960, the market holds historical value and has been a central point for fresh produce in Mumbai for decades.

Challenges

Food Waste: Some visitors have expressed concerns about the significant amount of food waste observed in the market, suggesting a need for better waste management practices.

Infrastructure Developments: Ongoing construction of a new road over-bridge has led to the relocation of several fruit vendors within the market premises, causing temporary disruptions.

Visiting Tips

Timing: For the best selection, consider visiting early in the morning when the market is most active.

Bargaining: Engaging in price negotiations is common and can lead to better deals.

Navigation: Due to its bustling nature, it's advisable to be cautious and aware of your surroundings while navigating through the market.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Even though we live near Dadar, love coming here just to come to Food Square at Santacruz.

A lush, spacious offering of the best in fresh fruits, vegetables and everything from A-Z in the imported zone.

We love the tastings of the cheese, fresh assorted breads, fruits, guacamole, pasta. A visual tasting experience before buying the product adds a personal touch to make the right buying choice.

Though the prices are expensive, there is something for everyone.

The ground floor further accentuates into a dining experience provided from the Barn, Zinque Patisserie, and so much more.

Their cheese platters are the best. And they let you try cheese with crackers and fruit.

You get every exotic fruit and vegetable. The likes of Amalfi lemons which I held for the first time in my hand, and sundries tomatoes from Italy and Spain. Every corner leaves you stunned.

Also appreciate the ‘ancient grains’ millet space which has the healthiest amaranth, bajra, jowar,quinoa and you name it.

Always keep coming back to here, never knew that a grocery shopping space could be so therapeutic and feel good.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Modi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly suspect they might be selling food past its expiry date.

Ordered multiple different items of their freeze dried food. Placed the order on 19-Apr-2026 and the package was delivered on 21-Apr-2026.

None of the packets have a date of manufacture or a best before date on the label. That alone is a red flag and possibly against FSSAI regulation.

However, every single packet had an additional sticker stating the date of manufacture is 20-Apr-2026. Which is highly unlikely given we ordered 8 different items. It is one thing to not properly label the date of manufacture on your products, it is another to deliberately try and mislead your customers.

Most of the packets have collected a lot of dust so they clearly weren't packed one day ago, let alone the food having been manufactured one day ago.

featured_reviews.name: Jagendra Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this Amir fruit shop, and honestly, it was an amazing experience! The moment I walked in, I was impressed by how fresh and colorful everything looked. The fruits were perfectly arranged, clean, and shining with freshness. From juicy mangoes and sweet apples to exotic berries and seasonal specialties, everything was available under one roof.

What I loved the most was the quality. Every fruit I bought was fresh, ripe, and full of flavor. You can truly taste the difference compared to regular market stalls. The prices were also very reasonable considering the premium quality.

The staff was polite, helpful, and very friendly. They guided me in choosing the best fruits and even suggested what was perfectly ripe for the day. The shop was neat, hygienic, and well-maintained, which made the shopping experience even better.

If you are looking for fresh, high-quality fruits with great service, this is definitely the place to visit. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
